findings.justification: wireframe does not define an offline state. The outage messages come from the connection band and activity panel, so the conversation pane is the gap.
findings.suspected_root_cause: hypothesis: WorkspaceView.tsx line 42 sets live from provenance.kind === 'daemon' even when the daemon is down; line 59 listLoading stays true because projectList.data is null and status is never 'error'; line 177 resolveKey returns null while loading && live, so the pane renders 'Loading conversations…' indefinitely.

findings.justification: wireframe does not define an empty state. The slot count is a separate source (ActivityPanel.tsx slots value, fixture mode).
findings.suspected_root_cause: empty scenario only swaps task and workstream sources (harness.ts createFixtureSources scenario); slot capacity source is not scenario-scoped.
